discordNotifications.heading: Discord Notifications
discordNotifications.description: Error and status notifications (sorter errors, jams, sync failures, card search errors) post to the channel picked with /notify-channel in your linked Discord server.
discordNotifications.notifyToggleDescription: Posts the card's name, price, and image to Discord each time one is scanned.
discordNotifications.testHintNotLinked: Link a Discord server above and run /notify-channel to enable test notifications

testNoChannel.title: No error channel set
testNoChannel.description: Run /notification in your Discord server, in the channel you want error notifications in, then try again.
